currentPage.description: Current 1-based page number to render. Consumers supply a new value after loading data.

pageSize.description: Current page size to render. Consumers supply a new value after loading data.

firstItem.description: First item number on the current page (for summary)

react.description: React calculates this value from currentPage, pageSize, and totalItems.

lastItem.description: Last item number on the current page (for summary)

react.description: React calculates this value from currentPage, pageSize, and totalItems.

itemLabel.description: Noun for items in the summary (e.g. 'results', 'records')

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the outer wrapper
